description: Frozen behaviour of the deterministic clinical core. The Python port in care_careloop must reproduce this exactly. Codes (LOINC/SNOMED) are NOT covered — see C12 in docs/REVAMP-PLAN.md.

step.summary: Very poorly controlled. Medium-dose ICS-formoterol MART plus a short oral corticosteroid course, urgent clinician contact, and respiratory specialist referral.
step.patientGoal: Get your breathing stable quickly and have a clinician review you within the next few days.

medications.sig: Inhale 2 puffs twice daily, plus 1 puff as needed for symptoms (max 12 puffs/day)
Inhale 2 puffs every 4-6 hours as needed for shortness of breath or wheeze
Take 2 tablets (40 mg) by mouth once daily for 5 days
